text.title: shadcn/ui Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on whether the stack can compile Tailwind utility strings and resolve path aliases, on whether supply-chain policy tolerates vendored source, and on whether components are already vendored and edited — to a full adoption, ownership-mode maintenance, or skip.

decision-tree.root-question: Is this a React project with Tailwind in the build pipeline and a bundler that resolves the configured path aliases?

branch.when: react == false || tailwind_in_build == false || aliases_resolved == false

conclusion.verdict: skip; the variants are Tailwind utility strings and the imports are alias paths — without both there is nothing to compile or resolve them against

branch.when: react == true && tailwind_in_build == true && aliases_resolved == true
branch.question: Does policy require every UI dependency to be a versioned npm package with an advisory feed and an `npm audit` surface?

conclusion.verdict: skip; vendored components carry no version and no advisory feed, so they pass review only because nothing scans them

branch.question: Have components already been vendored under the `ui` alias and edited in place?

conclusion.verdict: apply in maintenance mode: never re-run `add` over an edited file — diff upstream changes in by hand and keep the `@radix-ui/react-*` versions pinned as direct dependencies
apply from the top: `components.json` aliases matching `tsconfig` paths, `cn()` merging `className` last, `asChild` for polymorphism, no app logic under the `ui` alias
